Subject: Brightline MAP & CS handoff — kickoff, roles, and 60-day evaluation plan

Hi all,

Thanks again for finalizing the agreement — excited to get Brightline live. Attaching the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP), the signed SOW, and a short onboarding roadmap to kick things off.

What this thread is for: a formal handoff from Sales to Customer Success so we have clear owners, milestones, and an evaluation plan for the first 60 days post-launch. Please see the proposed timeline below and let me know if any adjustments are needed.

High-level milestones (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): Contract signed, kickoff meeting, access & API keys exchanged.
- Week 1–2: Integration (test environment), initial dataset ingestion, SE validation.
- Week 3–4: Pilot evaluation with 1–2 internal teams, performance/quality checks.
- Week 5–8: Rollout to staging/limited prod, finalize configs, monitor cost/latency.

Success criteria (evaluation plan)
- Service availability to Brightline test users >= 99% during pilot windows
- Inference p50 latency < 200ms, p95 < 500ms on typical payloads
- False positive rate on content moderation under 2% (per your eval sheet)
- Integration completed and acceptance signoff by Brightline product owner

Proposed assignments
- Sales sponsor / handoff owner: Diego Fernandez (me) — I’ll remain on-deck through week 4 for escalations and procurement coordination.
- CS lead (post-signature owner): Monica Patel — CS onboarding, runbooks, success plan.
- Technical lead / SE: Soojin Lee — architecture review, integration support, performance tuning.
- Brightline technical contact: Patricia Gomez (cc’d), procurement lead: Tom Reynolds (cc’d).

Next steps & asks
1) Monica/CS: Can you confirm you have capacity to lead the onboarding and suggest a kickoff slot?
2) Patricia/Tom: Please share the test API key or a sandbox endpoint and a sample dataset slice (PII redacted) for week 1 validation.
3) Procurement: confirm invoice contact and PO number if available.

Suggested kickoff windows (Pacific)
- Wednesday Nov 04, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Thursday Nov 05, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

Attachments included: Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners & dates), SOW_signed.pdf, Onboarding-Roadmap.pdf

I’ll also upload the MAP to a shared drive and post the link in this thread once ready.

Thanks — Diego
